doc.description:
Show the RTP/JPEG video of an aircraft (module video_rtp_stream) in the PprzGCS video panel, or in a GStreamer window of its own.
examples: video_to_gcs.sh -i 5000 -o 5600 -r counterclockwise front camera of the course Bebop to PprzGCS video_to_gcs.sh -i 6000 -w bottom camera in a window

option.description: RTP port of the stream (default 5000; the second camera of video_rtp_stream is 6000)
UDP port of the PprzGCS video panel (default 5600, layout: <widget name="video"><configure source="udp://:5600"/></widget>)
show the video in a GStreamer window instead of sending it to PprzGCS
